title: A Scientist Spilled 2 Drops Organic Mercury On Her Hand. This Is What Happened To Her Brain.
summary: Chubbyemu narrates the true case of a professor who spilled two drops of dimethylmercury on her hand and suffered fatal neurological damage.
why: Cited as the best accessible account of dimethylmercury poisoning, and as an example of the channel's grim medical case studies.

quote.text: ChubbyEmu’s video [1] on this was quite good.
